title: Self-Forecasting Scorecard
dataSources: Forecasts (`prediction:forecast`), resolved outcomes (`prediction:outcome`), personal bets (`bet:personal`), calibration scores (`calibration:score`), Brier scores (`brier:score`).
app: Personal forecasting and calibration — a private prediction journal of dated forecasts about your own life, resolved outcomes, and calibration / Brier scoring — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal (sourcetype=prediction:outcome OR sourcetype=brier:score)
| stats count(eval(sourcetype="prediction:outcome")) as resolved, avg(eval(if(result="correct",1,0))) as hit_rate, avg(brier) as avg_brier
| eval hit_pct=round(100*hit_rate,1), brier=round(avg_brier,3)
description: Combines your hit rate, calibration, and Brier score into one self-forecasting scorecard.
value: One scorecard summarises how good a forecaster of your own life you have become — the ultimate self-knowledge metric.
implementation: Combine forecasting feeds in `index=personal`; roll up accuracy and calibration.
visualization: Summary panel of hit rate, calibration, and Brier score.
grandmaExplanation: It sums up how good you are at predicting your own life into one honest scorecard of self-knowledge.
